latest.basis: Latest complete FY actual source for approved CFO/CapEx/DA carry-forward ratios, not a forecast.

forecastActuals.workingCapitalBasis: Arithmetic mean of five consecutive annual change-in-NWC/revenue ratios. Change in NWC = negative FMP cash-flow changeInWorkingCapital (includes other operating working capital); positive increases consume cash. Not a difference of only receivables, inventories and payables.
